reason: After thorough review of the 10-K filing for Greif, Inc. (fiscal year ended October 31, 2024), no total addressable market (TAM) disclosure was found. The filing contains extensive information about the company's business segments (Global Industrial Packaging, Paper Packaging and Services, and Land Management), operations in over 35 countries, and product lines, but does not include any company-disclosed TAM figures, market size estimates, or addressable market data. The company describes its business activities and operations but does not quantify the total market opportunity in any of its filings.
